definition: Loab ( LOBE) is a fictional character that artist and writer Steph Maj Swanson claimed to have discovered with a text-to-image AI model in April 2022.
details: In a viral Twitter thread, Swanson described the images of Loab as an unexpectedly emergent property of the software, saying they discovered them when asking the model to produce something "as different from the prompt as possible".
story: Picture a child pointing at pictures in a book — cat, car, cloud — learning to see by seeing a thousand examples. It turns a picture into an understanding: this is a cat, that is a stop sign. What your eyes do without thinking, the machine does one careful layer at a time. It is eyes made of arithmetic — pixels become edges, edges become shapes, shapes become meaning. And that is Loab — giving a machine the gift of sight.
